review.finding: Compact pane selection has two independent sources of truth, so programmatic Viewer or Terminal selection can disagree with panel sizing.
review.suggestion: Control TaskDetailThreePane from TaskDetailPage and cover file-to-Viewer and hotkey-to-Terminal in a real browser.

review.finding: ResizeObserver and window repaint paths can call safeFit while the compact terminal pane is inactive and zero-sized.
review.suggestion: Gate fitting on active and measurable state, retaining delayed activation fit after reveal.

review.finding: Manually returning from Activity to Detail does not update the Detail close return destination.
review.suggestion: Record the current Overview or Activity panel before manually entering Detail.

review.finding: Desktop artifact selection overwrites the preserved compact destination.
review.suggestion: Only change compact navigation state when the compact layout is active.

review.finding: Shiplog falls back to a 36px target at the md breakpoint inside the compact tablet range.
review.suggestion: Retain 44px through 1023px and shrink only at lg.

review.finding: The workspace tabs lack tab-to-panel relationships and inactive compact panels remain keyboard-reachable.
review.suggestion: Add ids and aria-controls, tabpanel labelling, and inert on inactive mounted panes.

review.finding: The t shortcut reveals Terminal but synchronously focuses xterm before React removes inert from the centre pane.
review.suggestion: Defer focus until the controlled centre pane has committed and assert the real active element in Playwright.

review.finding: A hidden-terminal size-sync guard could let auto-launch continue without the pre-dispatch width correction.
review.suggestion: Block dispatch until the pane is active and size-sync succeeds; cover hidden-to-visible launch ordering.

review.finding: The mobile browser spec crossed the repository's 300-line limit.
review.suggestion: Extract cohesive geometry assertions into the E2E helper.

review.finding: The initial resize assertion ran too early to prove that every later frame on the socket remained usable.
review.suggestion: Re-assert all resize frames since socket open at the end of the terminal scenario.
